read_with: Claude in Chrome on the documentation page (the owner's browser): the spec parsed in the page (js-yaml 4.1.0), every GET operation written out by the extraction below, the text checked byte for byte against the browser's SHA-256

format.## GET <path> [<tag>] <operationId> :: <: one block per operation, in the spec's order
format.P name|in|req|type|format|enum|pattern|m: one per parameter; enum values joined with '/', 'req' when required; a pattern may itself hold '|' (the last five columns are fixed)
format.D <line>: the operation's description, one line each, table separators dropped, spaces collapsed
format.F <skeleton>: the documented 200 example's `response` part as a typed tree: R = response, '[]' an array, s string, n number, b boolean, z null in the example (type unknown), a empty array, {} object
the example's envelope fields (get, parameters, errors, results, paging)

notes: The examples are the provider's illustrations, not a schema: fields added later (changelog 3.9.3: fixtures league.standings) and the per-fixture blocks returned by fixtures?id / ids (events, lineups, statistics, players) are not in them. The field-coverage audit adds the fields observed in RAW payloads.
The API key never appears here: the documentation's placeholder XxXxXxXx... was not kept.
